title: Construction of an Annex Building at the District Hospital
summary: Tailored eligibility criteria allow exactly one vendor (V-047) to qualify. V-047 is a member of flagged ring R-1 (shared director P-010 and shared address A-007 with V-045 and V-046). High risk of bid rigging.
reasoning: The Z3 solver confirms that the eligibility criteria (CL2 Class-A, CL3 turnover >= 100 cr, CL4 experience >= 15 yrs) are satisfiable by exactly one of 200 registered vendors: V-047 (Apex Constructions Ltd). Graph analysis reveals V-047 shares director Rajesh Mehta (P-010) and registered address 42 MG Road, Bengaluru (A-007) with V-045 and V-046, forming ring R-1 with a collusion score of 0.91. The Manual for Procurement of Works (KB-014, Para 3.9.1 (4)) says qualification criteria should be unrestrictive enough not to leave out even one capable contractor and must consider the adequacy of competition; GFR 2017 Rule 175 (KB-013) lists collusion and bid rigging as breaches of the code of integrity. The convergence of tailored criteria and network collusion indicators warrants immediate escalation.
recommended_actions: Escalate to the Chief Vigilance Officer (CVO) for examination of eligibility criteria.
Investigate the relationship between the tender-issuing authority and V-047 / director P-010.
Cross-check past tenders won by V-045, V-046, V-047 for patterns of rotation or cover bidding.
Suspend tender evaluation pending investigation outcome.
disclaimer: Risk indicators only; not a finding of wrongdoing. Recommendation requires human review.
